title: Am Heedbrink, Dortmund
description:
Fully Furnished WG in a Shared Apartment

This WG is fully furnished and equipped with all essential amenities for a comfortable stay. The apartment consists of 7 rooms, a spacious kitchen, 1 shower, and 1 WC.

Amenities:
Furnished Room: Each room includes a desk, chair, open wardrobe, and bed.
Kitchen Facilities: The kitchen is fully equipped with a fridge, oven, kettle, toaster, and necessary utensils.
A washing machine and Wi-Fi are provided for tenants.

Location: The apartment is conveniently located . It takes 25 to 35 minutes to reach TU Dortmund University by public transport from the apartment. For daily necessities, there are several shops in close proximity.

Additional Information:
Tenants are responsible for maintaining the cleanliness of the apartment throughout their stay.
A one-time membership fee of €76 applies.
Upon move-out, tenants are required to pay a mandatory bed linen fee of €30 and a cleaning fee of €130.

title: Gibbenhey, Dortmund
description:
Möblierte 2-Zimmer-Wohnung in Dortmund-Eichlinghofen zu vermieten

Ideal für Pendler, Studierende, Monteure und Handwerker aber auch für Langzeit Mieter: Wir bieten eine vollmöblierte 2-Zimmer-Wohnung direkt neben dem Campus der Technischen Universität Dortmund mit exzellenter Anbindung an Bus, Bahn und Autobahnen.

Details zur Wohnung:
• Wohnfläche: 40 m2
• 2 Zimmer, Balkon, Flur, Badezimmer, Kochnische
• Vollmöbliert inkl. Küche, Waschmaschine, Sofa, Arbeitstische, Bett
• Wenn gewollt können Sie auch ihre privaten Möbel mitnehmen.
• Badezimmer mit Dusche
• Aufzug vorhanden – barrierefrei
• Parkmöglichkeiten in der Tiefgarage

Lage:
• Nur 1 Minute Fußweg zur TU Dortmund

Mietkonditionen:
• Mindestmietdauer: 3 Monate
• Kaution: 1.000 €
• Maximal 3 Bewohner

Für weitere Informationen senden Sie bitte eine Nachricht mit Ihrem vollständigen Namen, Adresse und Rückrufnummer. Ohne diese Angaben können wir Ihre Anfrage leider nicht bearbeiten.

Kontaktieren Sie uns jetzt und sichern Sie sich diese komfortable Wohnung!

title: Hauptstraße, Herdecke
description:
(hidden): Stil, Flair, Zentral & Naturnah 
 Historic old town center meets a quiet location by the stream. Centrally located and ideal for couples. Welcome to your compact unit in the heart of Herdecke..
.
.
# Welcome.
.
This fully equipped 34 m2 ground-floor apartment is the perfect choice for guests seeking short distances and a functional layout:.
.
- For Couples & Solo Travelers: The separate bedroom with a King-size double bed offers high comfort for a relaxed stay..
.
- For Hospital Visitors & Students: Proximity to the Herdecke Community Hospital and the University of Witten/Herdecke makes this apartment a strategically ideal base..
.
- For Nature Lovers & Cyclists: Located between Lake Harkort and Lake Hengstey. The stream directly behind the house ensures a quiet atmosphere right in the center..
.
.
# The Apartment.
.
This 34 m2 ground-floor apartment offers an efficient and bright layout. The unit is ideally designed for two people: a separate bedroom with a King-size double bed and a Smart TV ensures privacy. The living-dining area with an integrated kitchen forms the functional center of the apartment..
.
.
# Highlights.
.
- King-Size Comfort: A large double bed and a Smart TV in the separate bedroom..
.
- Top Location: Directly in the historic Herdecke old town – all important points are within walking distance..
.
- Quiet Backdrop: A stream runs directly behind the property, providing a pleasant atmosphere..
.
- Fully Equipped: Compact kitchen with a dishwasher and microwave for effortless self-catering..
.
.
# Amenities.
.
- Living & Sleeping: Separate bedroom with King-size double bed and Smart TV. Living-dining area with seating..
.
- Kitchen & Household: The separate kitchen offers everything for self-catering: ceramic hob, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. Coffee maker, toaster, and kettle are provided..
.
- Bath & Comfort: Functional bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Heating is provided by a reliable gas boiler..
.
- Internet: Stay connected with fast Wi-Fi throughout the apartment..
.
- Building & Access: Full temporal flexibility during check-in thanks to modern smart locks (code access)..
.
.
# About the Surroundings.
.
Your strategic location: In the "City between the Lakes," where Westphalian coziness meets modern infrastructure..
.
.
# Location & Connectivity.
.
- Public Transport: Herdecke station (connections to Dortmund/Hagen) is reachable in approx. 6 minutes on foot (450 m)..
.
- Hospital Proximity: The Herdecke Community Hospital is approx. 2.5 km away (approx. 5 min by car)..
.
- Center: The marketplace with restaurants and shops is only approx. 500 m away..
.
- Nature: The Ruhr river and the promenade at Lake Harkort are reachable in approx. 15 minutes on foot..
.
.
# Your Fast Path to Destinations:.
.
- Target: Herdecke Old Town / Center | Transport: Foot | Duration: approx. 5 minutes.
.
- Target: Herdecke Station | Transport: Foot | Duration: approx. 6 minutes.
.
- Target: Harkortsee Promenade | Transport: Foot / Bike | Duration: approx. 15 / 5 min..
.
- Target: Community Hospital | Transport: Car / Bus | Duration: approx. 5 / 10 min..
.
.
# Shopping & Local Supplies.
.
Everything for daily needs is located in the city center: supermarkets, bakeries, and drugstores are reachable within 5 to 10 minutes on foot..
.
.
# Gastronomy & Going Out.
.
Herdecke's old town offers diverse gastronomy. Whether traditional inns or modern cafes – numerous options are located within a radius of only 500 m..
.
.
# Leisure & Recreation.
.
Take advantage of the location for outdoor activities:.
.
- Lake Harkort & Lake Hengstey: Ideal for hiking, running, or water sports..
- Herdecke Viaduct: An impressive architectural monument in the immediate vicinity..
- Ruhr Valley Cycle Path: Perfect for extensive bike tours along the river..
.
.
# Host's Insider Tips.
.
- Tip 1 (View): A trip to the Koepchenwerk offers a spectacular view over the Ruhr Valley..
.
- Tip 2 (Idyll): The area around Bachplatz shows the old town at its best..
.
- Tip 3 (Culinary): Visit the small cafes in the pedestrian zone for homemade cakes..
.
- Tip 4 (Historical): The Herdecke local history museum offers exciting insights into the city's history..
.
- Tip 5 (Active): A canoe tour on the Ruhr offers a whole new perspective on the city..
.
.
# Important Notes on Accommodation & Location.
.
The apartment is located on the ground floor, offering easy access..
.
Please note that the apartment does not have a washing machine or dryer. However, thanks to the central location, all services are reachable nearby. The 34 m2 are compact and functionally designed – ideal for guests seeking a central base..
.
---.
.

title: Glückaufsegenstraße, Dortmund
description:
Schöne, helle Maisonette-Wohnung mit sehr guter U-Bahn, Auto und Park-Anbindung in Do-Hacheney

Schicke Maisonette Wohnung in einer ruhig gelegen Straße. Gute Anbindung an die B 54, die Dortmunder Innenstadt ist so in wenigen Minuten zu erreichen. Parkmöglichkeiten sind in der Straße vorhanden. Eine U-Bahn Haltestelle ist ca. 1 km entfernt, hier hält die Linie U49, welche in die Innenstadt fährt (10min bis zum HBF) . Der beliebte Rombergpark/ Botanischer Garten und der Westfalenpark befindet sich in der Nähe und lädt zum entspannen ein. Im Mietpreis von 950,- € sind die Betriebskosten, Nebenkosten, Fahrrad und W-LAN enthalten. Strom ist zzgl. zu zahlen und wird nach Verbrauch abgerechnet. 1 Monatsmiete Kaution. Die Wohnung ist ggfl als WG geeignet, dann liegen die Kosten aber um 150,- höher!  Die Endreinigung wird nach Aufwand berechnet. Ein Energieausweis liegt vermieterseits noch nicht vor, ist jedoch angefragt. Einen virtueller Rundgang ist hier möglich: (hidden)

Das Objekt liegt in belebter Gegend in Dortmund Hacheney. Mehrere Bus- und Straßenbahnlinien sind fußläufig zu erreichen. In direkter Umgebung finden Sie mehrere Restaurants, Cafés und zwei Bäckereien vor. Außerdem gibt es verschiedene Grün- und Parkanlagen, Schwimmbad, Fitnessstudios, mehrere Discounter (Aldi, Lidl, Rewe, Netto), uvm. Auch das BVB Stadion ist fussläufig zu erreichen. Die Innenstadt von  Dortmund ist dem Fahrrad oder der Bahn innerhalb von 10 min zu erreichen. 

Die Wohnung ist komplett möbliert und eingerichtet. Im 2. OG befindet sich das Schlafzimmer mit offenen Wohnbereich. Das Bett hat die Maße 1,40 x 2,00 Meter. Der Fernseher (Flachbild-TV) verfügt über eine Smart-Funktion mit Apple TV.. Im Dachgeschoss befindet sich die Küche, ein Essbereich, ein Arbeitsbereich mit Schreibtisch und der Zugang zum Badezimmer. Zum Kücheninventar zählen u.a. 2-er Ceranfeld, Kühlschrank mit Eisfach, Backofen, Kaffeemaschine, Spülmaschine u.v.m. Das Badezimmer beinhaltet ein Fenster und eine Dusche mit Sitzmöglichkeit. Die Internet-Flatrate ist im Mietpreis enthalten. Eine Waschmöglichkeit steht im Keller zur Verfügung. Ein Fahrrad (inkl. Helm, Schloss und Fahrradtaschen) für die eigene Nutzung ist im Mietpreis enthalten.


Stylish maisonette apartment in a quiet street. Good connections to the B 54 motorway, allowing you to reach Dortmund city centre in just a few minutes. Parking is available on the street. An underground station is approx. 1 km away, where the U49 line stops, which goes to the city centre (10 minutes to the main station). The popular Rombergpark/Botanical Garden and Westfalenpark are nearby and invite you to relax. The rent of €950 includes operating costs, ancillary costs, bicycle and WiFi. Electricity is payable separately and is billed according to consumption.  The flat is eventually suitable as a shared flat. Than for 150,- more. 1 month's rent deposit. Final cleaning will be charged according to the amount of work involved. An energy certificate is not yet available from the landlord, but has been requested.

The property is located in a lively area in Dortmund Hacheney. Several bus and tram lines are within walking distance. There are several restaurants, cafés and two bakeries in the immediate vicinity. There are also various green spaces and parks, public swimming pool, several discounters (Aldi, Lidl, Rewe, Netto), gyms, and a lot more. The BVB stadium is also within walking distance..

Facilities: The apartment is fully furnished and equipped. The bedroom with open-plan living area is located on the 2nd floor. The bed measures 1.40 x 2.00 metres. The television (flat screen) has a smart function with Apple TV. The kitchen, dining area, work area with desk and access to the bathroom are located in the attic. The kitchen inventory includes a 2-ring ceramic hob, refrigerator with freezer compartment, dishwasher, oven, coffee machine and much more. The bathroom has a window and a shower with a seat. The flat-rate internet connection is included in the rent. Washing facilities are available in the basement. A bicycle (including helmet, lock and bicycle bags) for your own use is included in the rental price.
